title: Tokenization and Tagging
description: Begins with a plain-language explanation of language-aware tokenization and tag enums, then traces the corresponding implementation and its limits in sign-language-to-text-translation.
learning_objectives: Explain language-aware tokenization and tag enums in plain language and connect it to sign_language_translator/text/tokenizer.py; sign_language_translator/text/tagger.py.
Trace one input through the tokenization and tagging stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
practical_outcomes: Trace the tokenization and tagging stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for language-aware tokenization and tag enums.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
